description:
In 1948, the "liberation period" was not as free as its name suggests. Hae Ran, a designer who frees customers from their secrets at Gyeongseong Lingerie Shop, the first underwear shop in Joseon, is actually "Salsu" who assassinates anti-nationalists every full moon night under the orders of Heukyeong. Hae Ran, who is living a double life, is chased by the police officer Seok Ju one day, and collapses after someone finds out her identity... A warm hand that I feel for the first time in my life. Who was the benefactor that day who healed my wounds and protected me? Meanwhile, Heukyeong infiltrates the office disguised as a designer who studied abroad in order to keep an eye on Salsu. But the two of them end up harboring feelings for each other…

*"Was our relationship… the key to escaping the cage? Or was it the shackles that bound us?"*

A love triangle of liberation between three youths who chased each other’s tails to escape their cages.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
